title: Fix Vulkan ERROR_INITIALIZATION_FAILED on older AMD GPUs
summary: Older AMD GPUs (GCN1/GCN2) require enabling SI/CIK support in the amdgpu driver to work with Vulkan.

steps.explain: Check if the amdgpu driver is correctly loaded for your GPU.
steps.expect: Kernel driver in use: amdgpu for your VGA controller.

steps.explain: Edit your bootloader configuration to add 'amdgpu.si_support=1 amdgpu.cik_support=1' to the kernel parameters. See AMDGPU#Enable Southern Islands (SI) and Sea Islands (CIK) support for details.

rollback.explain: Revert the changes made to the bootloader configuration.

warnings: Modifying kernel parameters can make the system unbootable if done incorrectly. Ensure you have a backup or recovery method.
